title: Assistant Brand Manager - Quick & Easy Meals
description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your marketing career and build your experience across some of the UK's most recognised food brands?

We're looking for an ambitious and commercially minded Assistant Brand Manager to join our Quick & Easy Meals team. You'll support the delivery of brand strategy, innovation and commercial performance across brands including Batchelors Cup a Soup, Batchelors Pasta 'n' Sauce and FUEL10 K, while taking day-to-day ownership of the Batchelors Smash brand.

This is a varied, hands-on role where you'll work with colleagues across Sales, Category, Insights, Finance, R&D and Supply Chain. From analysing brand performance and spotting growth opportunities to delivering campaigns and taking innovation projects from concept through to launch, you'll have the opportunity to develop broad brand management experience and make a visible contribution to the growth of the category.

What you'll be doing?
- Supporting the Senior Brand Manager to deliver growth plans across our Soup and Quick & Easy Meals portfolio
- Taking ownership of the day-to-day management and performance of Batchelors Smash
- Monitoring brand, category and competitor performance, turning data and insights into clear recommendations
- Supporting the development and execution of annual brand plans, campaigns and commercial initiatives
- Leading allocated innovation and renovation projects from initial concept through to launch
- Managing packaging changes, artwork development and product updates through the Stage & Gate process
- Delivering consumer and shopper activation programmes across key channels, on time and within budget
- Building strong relationships across Sales, Category, Insights, Finance, R&D and Supply Chain
- Identifying emerging consumer trends and new opportunities to strengthen brand performance and drive profitable growth.

What we need from you?

You'll be a proactive and results-focused marketer who enjoys taking ownership, working collaboratively and turning insight into action.

Ideally, you'll bring:
- Experience in a marketing or brand management role, preferably within FMCG
- Strong commercial and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and develop clear actions
- The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- A collaborative approach and the confidence to work across a range of functions
- A results-orientated mindset, with experience of taking ownership and delivering measurable outcomes
- Graduate-level capability or equivalent relevant experience

What we offer you in return?
- Competitive salary and bonus
- Up to 7.5% pension
- Private medical insurance and life assurance
- Hybrid working (50% home / 50% office or site)
- Sharesave scheme and the option to purchase additional holiday
- Extensive learning and development opportunities
- Access to a wide employee discount scheme

Ready to apply?

Click Apply and submit your CV tailored to this opportunity. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Communications Officer
description:
Job Title:Communications Officer
Starting Salary: £35,570 - £38,510per annum (pro rata for part time)
Hours: 37
Location: Stevenage, Hybrid - countywide travel
Contract Type:Permanent
Directorate:Resources

About the team

The Corporate Communications team helps Hertfordshire County Council communicate clearly, consistently and effectively with colleagues, residents, partners and stakeholders. We support services across the organisation to engage audiences, manage reputation and tell the stories that showcase the difference we make to communities across Hertfordshire.

You'll join a collaborative and supportive team of communications professionals, working alongside colleagues across media, campaigns, digital and internal communications. Together, we deliver strategic communications that inform, engage and inspire.

About the role

If you're creative, curious and keen to make a real difference, this is a great opportunity to develop your communications career while helping us shape how residents understand and engage with council services. You'll be encouraged to get out into our communities, uncover great stories, create engaging content and help communicate information that matters to people's everyday lives. In return, you'll gain experience across a wide range of communications disciplines, build valuable skills and play an important role in showcasing the positive impact Hertfordshire County Council has on communities across the county.

About you

Essential:
- Experience of creating engaging, accessible content tailored to different audiences and communication channels.
- Experience of identifying and developing stories and case studies
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to write clearly in plain English and adapt messages for different audiences.
- Experience of building and maintaining effective relationships.
- Ability to manage multiple projects, monitor progress and deliver communications activity to agreed deadlines.

Desirable:
- Demonstrable experience of developing and delivering communications activity across a range of channels, including digital, print and media.
- Proven ability to gather, analyse and interpret information, audience insight and performance data to inform communications plans and campaigns.
- Awareness of the media landscape, news agenda and the role of communications in supporting organisational priorities.
- Experience of evaluating communications activity and using insights to improve future performance.
- Experience of working in local government, the public sector or a large, complex organisation.
- Knowledge of media relations and responding to media enquiries.

Qualifications:
- Relevant qualification in communications, public relations, marketing, journalism or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

Other Requirements:
- Ability to travel across Hertfordshire to attend events, gather content and build relationships with stakeholders and communities as required.
- You will be required to be part of an on-call out of hours rota. You will be on-call roughly once a quarter and will be paid. Full training will be provided.

We welcome applications from candidates who currently reside in the UK with established proof of right to work documentation. We are not able to offer sponsorship at this time for this role.

This job role is Level 9. Please locate the job profile here:

To hear more about this opportunity please contact Nick Pearce, Senior Communications Manager

Interview Date: w/c 16/11/2026

How to apply

As part of your application, please upload your most recent CV. Ensure your CV is up to date with your employment history (including any employment gaps), and including any training/qualifications. We encourage you to include examples of where you have demonstrated the requirements/criteria in the advert / job profile to allow the panel to fully recognise your skills and abilities. You will have the opportunity to include a short covering paragraph within your application to give us a little more information about your skills, knowledge, and experiences.

Additional information

We are changing
Hertfordshire County Councilis undergoing Local Government Reorganisation (LGR). If you are employed by Hertfordshire County on 1 April 2028, it is expected that most roles will transfer to the newly-created unitary councils on existing terms and conditions under TUPE (Transfer of Undertakings - Protection of Employment) principles.

LGR is one of the biggest changes we will face in a generation. It will reshape how we work and how services are organised and gives us a real opportunity to build something better. To find out more, visit

DisabilityConfident
We are proud to be a and guarantee an interview to anyone disclosing a disability whose application meets the minimum criteria for the post.

English Fluency
The ability to converse at ease with members of the public and provide advice in accurate spoken English is essential for the post (for those whose language is a signed language the provision of a sign language interpreter who speaks English to the necessary standard of fluency will be required).

title: Digital Marketing Executive
company: The Institution of Engineering & Technology - Agency - Permanent
description:
- Are you passionate about developing and delivering digital marketing campaigns that drive engagement, align with strategic objectives, and achieve measurable impact?
- Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multi-channel campaigns, optimising digital strategies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure success?
- Could you be our next Digital Marketing Executive, helping to deliver high-impact campaigns that drive attendance, registrations and engagement across the IET's events, learning and awards portfolios?

At the IET, making our world a better place starts by creating a better place for our people. At the IET you'll have more than just a job. Our work is exciting and challenging, connecting the people who solve the problems that matter. It means working with us has real meaning and impact, and you'll grow - professionally and personally - in ways you never thought possible. We're also making significant investments in our people, including providing a modern, vibrant workplace and embracing hybrid working.

What you'll be doing

As a Digital Marketing Executive, you will play a key role in delivering and optimising our digital marketing campaigns across multiple platforms. With a focus on email marketing, social media, digital advertising, content marketing, and web updates, you'll ensure our digital efforts are aligned with overall campaign objectives and best practices. This role will primarily support the IET's campaigns for events, courses and awards, and you will be joining a team of 20+ marketing campaign professionals.

You'll work closely with our Marketing Campaign Managers and Digital Marketing Specialists to execute impactful digital marketing tactics, monitor performance, and drive engagement. Your ability to analyse data and identify opportunities for optimisation will play a key part in improving campaign effectiveness and return on investment.

If you thrive in a dynamic environment, enjoy variety in your work, and love collaborating with stakeholders to deliver results, this role offers an exciting opportunity to develop and expand your digital marketing expertise.

What we hope you can bring to the role

We're looking for someone with hands-on experience in digital marketing, particularly across email marketing, organic and paid social media, PPC, and web content management. You'll bring a data-driven approach, strong organisational skills, and a keen eye for detail, ensuring digital marketing activities are effective, compliant, and optimised for best performance.

The ideal candidate will have experience using digital marketing tools, be confident in managing multiple projects, and have a passion for staying ahead of digital trends. Your ability to communicate effectively, analyse campaign performance, and collaborate with stakeholders will be essential.

A little more about the role
- Plan, build, and execute targeted email marketing campaigns, ensuring they are well-designed, engaging, and optimised for use (mobile, for example).
- Manage and schedule organic social media posts, ensuring alignment with platform best practices and analysing performance for optimisation.
- Assist in setting up and managing pay-per-click (PPC) campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads and social media.
- Regularly update and maintain website content using the Umbraco CMS, ensuring accuracy, SEO-friendliness, and a seamless user experience.
- Create, capture, edit and repurpose engaging campaign content for use across channels, including photography and video
- Monitor and analyse digital marketing performance across email, social media, PPC, and web, providing insights and recommendations to enhance engagement and ROI.
- Work closely with Marketing Campaign Managers to ensure cohesive messaging and integrated digital campaigns.
- Assist in conducting A/B tests for digital ads, emails, and landing pages to improve campaign effectiveness.
- Support budget management for digital campaigns, ensuring activities are cost-effective and deliver strong results.
- Stay up-to-date with data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR) and digital marketing best practices to ensure compliance and excellence in execution.

A little more about what we're looking for
- Proven experience in digital marketing, including email marketing, social media management, PPC, and web content management.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make data-driven decisions to optimise performance.
- Experience using email marketing platforms (e.g., Upland Adestra, Mailchimp), PPC/social ads management tools (e.g., Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads), social media management tools (e.g., Sprinklr, Hootsuite), and CMS platforms (e.g., Umbraco, WordPress).
- Experience creating or editing marketing content, including social media assets, photography and/or video content, with an understanding of how content should be adapted for different channels and audiences.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence in engaging with internal stakeholders and external audiences.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines efficiently.
- Proactive and eager to learn, with a passion for digital marketing and staying ahead of industry trends.
- A collaborative mindset, with experience working in cross-functional teams to achieve marketing goals.

If you're passionate about digital marketing and content creation, and are keen to develop your skills across digital marketing channels, this role offers a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience, supporting the successful deliver of the IET's Events, Learning and Courses campaigns.

This is a hybrid role based in Stevenage, with the team coming into the office twice per week. Our marketing team anchor day is Thursday. Occasional UK travel will also be required to support content capture at events, courses and other IET activities.

title: Internal Communications Manager
description:
Internal and Leadership Communications Manager

Hybrid St Albans

Shape how more than 20,000 Costa team members connect with our strategy, leaders and culture. You'll drive high-impact communications that build clarity, confidence and connection across our global business, partnering closely with senior leaders to bring Costa's priorities to life.

At Costa Coffee, we are what we craft. As part of The Coca-Cola System, we're bringing great coffee experiences to customers in over 50 countries across stores, machines, and on the go.

So, why Costa Coffee?

We're passionate about creating an environment where everyone can thrive. When you join Costa, you'll enjoy:
- Annual discretionary bonus
- Share Investment Plan through Coca-Cola
- Matched pension contributions up to 10%
- Private healthcare
- 50% discount in Costa-owned stores
- A range of wellbeing, financial and lifestyle benefits

We champion diversity, equity and inclusion, creating a culture where everyone can bring their authentic self to work.

What you'll do

You'll shape how Costa Coffee's team members understand where we're heading, why it matters and the part they play in our success. You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, turning Costa's priorities into a clear and compelling team member narrative. You'll:
- Own and deliver our internal and leadership communications strategy, annual plan and communications drumbeat, translating business priorities into a rhythm of campaigns, leadership moments and communication activity
- Shape executive and leadership communications across company-wide meetings, events and key strategic moments
- Lead communications planning and delivery for major business change and transformation initiatives, including complex or sensitive communications moments.
- Act as the communications lead for major business priorities, organisational change and strategic programmes
- Partner with senior and executive leaders, advising on communications strategy and stakeholder engagement, while working collaboratively across communications and business teams
- Set the measurement approach for internal communications, using insight to demonstrate impact and continuously improve

Who you are

You'll be an experienced communications leader who can move confidently between strategy, senior counsel and high-quality delivery. You'll bring:
- Extensive internal and leadership communications experience within a large, complex or global organisation
- A strong track record of translating business priorities into compelling narratives, supported by excellent writing, storytelling and stakeholder management skills
- Credibility and confidence advising, influencing and constructively challenging executive and senior leaders
- Proven leadership of high-profile campaigns, leadership events and multi-channel communications from strategy through to measurement
- Excellent judgement, with experience managing complex, sensitive and fast-moving communications
- Significant experience leading communications for change, transformation or organisational evolution
- Experience in retail, hospitality or FMCG would be useful, but isn't essential.

Where you'll work:

Our Support Centre teams work flexibly, combining home working with in-person collaboration. From January 2027, we'll be based in our new St Albans office, with teams coming together three days a week.

A rare opportunity to shape how one of the world's most recognised coffee brands communicates with its people, partnering with senior leaders to influence culture, engagement and business performance across a global organisation.

title: Marketing Executive
company: The Hospice of St Francis - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are looking for a creative, organised and hands-on Marketing Executive to join our Fundraising and Marketing team. Working across the whole Hospice, you will help deliver engaging campaigns and communications that raise awareness of our services, inspire support and strengthen our connection with local communities.

This is a varied delivery and coordination role. You will create content for our website, newsletters, email, organic social media and printed materials; help coordinate campaigns and events; gather stories, photography and video sensitively; and keep activity moving against agreed briefs, priorities and deadlines. You will also support routine website updates, social media scheduling, media activity, and digital campaigns.

You will bring practical experience in marketing, communications, content, or digital marketing, together with strong copywriting and proofreading skills. You will be confident in adapting your tone for different audiences, managing several deadlines, and working collaboratively with colleagues, volunteers, supporters, and suppliers. An understanding of consent, confidentiality, accessibility, and the sensitive use of personal stories and images is important.

The role is primarily Hospice-based, with hybrid working by agreement. Travel to Hospice sites, shops, events and community activities will be required, along with occasional flexibility outside normal hours for major campaigns, events or urgent communications.

If you are a practical marketer who combines creativity with excellent organisation and attention to detail, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Brand Manager - Batchelors - Quick and Easy Meals
description:
At Premier Foods, we're passionate about creating the food people love to eat every day. From much-loved cupboard staples to innovative meal solutions, our brands play an important role in households across the UK.

We're looking for an experienced and commercially minded Senior Brand Manager to join our Quick & Easy Meals team on a maternity cover basis. This is an exciting opportunity to lead brand strategy, drive growth and make a real impact within one of our key categories

As Senior Brand Manager, you'll be the champion for our Soup & Easy Meals portfolio, owning and delivering brand strategy and execution across the category. You'll play a pivotal role in driving growth, consumer engagement and commercial performance whilst influencing a broad range of stakeholders across the business.

Working closely with teams across Sales, Customer Marketing, Innovation, Insights, Category, Finance and R&D, you'll bring consumer insight, commercial thinking and creativity together to deliver winning plans that strengthen our brands and drive market share growth.

What you'll be doing
- Taking full accountability for brand performance, including P&L delivery, market share and conumer health metrics across the Soup & Easy Meals portfolio.
- Developing and implementing growth strategies that maximise consumer trial, penetration and setailer support.

- Partnering with retailer teams to deliver compelling activation programmes that drive category growth.

- Analysing brand performance data and translating insights into clear actions and recommendation

We're looking for a marketer who combines strategic thinking with a strong bias for action.

- A minimum of five years' experience within FMCG or another brand-led organisation.

- A proven track record of delivering successful projects and measurable business results.

title: Social & Content Executive - Consumer Brand/Fashion Lifestyle
description:
With over 40 years of experience, we're one of the UK's leading luggage and travel brands, continually pushing the boundaries of product innovation and bringing more than 150 new product ranges to market every year.

Recognised as the UK's Most Trusted Luggage Brand 2025, we're an established, internationally recognised consumer brand with ambitious plans for continued growth.

We're investing in our products, our people and our brands, and we're looking for an experienced Social & Content Executive to play a key role in how our brands show up across digital channels.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Social & Content Executive with a proven track record of creating and managing content for a consumer, fashion, lifestyle, travel, retail or e-commerce brand.

This is not a graduate or trainee position. We're looking for someone who can hit the ground running, take ownership of day-to-day social and content activity, and confidently create content as well as manage the process around it.

Reporting to the Creative Director, you'll help shape the social presence and content output of an established consumer brand, working across Instagram, TikTok, website, email and other digital channels.

You'll be involved in everything from product launches and campaign content to photography, video, influencer activity, community management and customer-facing copy.

What You'll Be Doing
- Own the day-to-day management of our social media channels, including Instagram and TikTok.
- Develop and deliver engaging social content that strengthens brand awareness and drives product consideration.
- Personally create and capture social-first content, including Reels, TikToks, photography, Stories and behind-the-scenes content.
- Plan content calendars and manage the end-to-end process from idea and briefing through to creation, scheduling, publishing and reporting.
- Support the planning and delivery of product photography and video shoots, including helping with concepts, shot lists, props, locations and content requirements.
- Capture additional content during product launches, campaigns, photoshoots, retail activity and events.
- Write high-quality social captions, product descriptions, website copy, email content and other customer-facing communications.
- Support influencer, creator, PR and brand partnership activity, including identifying relevant opportunities and coordinating content.
- Create content supporting new product launches, seasonal campaigns, retail initiatives and commercial activity.
- Manage day-to-day community engagement across social channels, responding to comments, messages and customer interactions in the brand's tone of voice.
- Monitor social and content performance, report on key metrics and use insights to improve future content.
- Stay ahead of social trends, platform developments and emerging content formats, understanding which trends are relevant to the brand and which are not.
- Work closely with the Creative Director and wider marketing team to ensure all content is commercially effective and consistent with our brand identity and tone of voice.

What We're Looking ForEssential
- 2+ years' professional experience in social media, content marketing or digital content creation.
- Proven experience working for a consumer-facing brand, agency or e-commerce business.
- Demonstrable experience managing social channels, particularly Instagram and TikTok.
- A portfolio showing real examples of professional social and content work.
- Strong hands-on content creation skills, including short-form video, photography and social-first creative.
- Excellent copywriting skills, with the ability to write engaging, commercially effective customer-facing content.
- Experience creating content for products, campaigns, launches or consumer brands.
- Strong understanding of social media trends, audience behaviour and platform best practice.
- Ability to manage content from concept through to production, publishing and performance analysis.
- Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

Highly Desirable
- Experience working in fashion, lifestyle, travel, luggage, retail, beauty or another physical consumer-product category.
- Experience working with e-commerce brands and understanding how social content supports online sales.
- Experience with product photography and/or videography.
- Experience working with influencers, creators and UGC.
- Experience with email marketing and website content.
- Experience using social scheduling and analytics platforms.
- Experience supporting photoshoots, campaigns and product launches.
- Experience working within established brand guidelines and tone of voice.

Important: Who This Role Is For

We're looking for someone who already has professional social and content experience and is ready to take ownership.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate professional work for a consumer, fashion, lifestyle, travel, retail or e-commerce brand.

Why Join Us?
- Join the UK's Most Trusted Luggage Brand 2025.
- Work on an established, internationally recognised consumer brand.
- Have genuine ownership of social and content activity.
- Work across product launches, campaigns, photography, video, influencers and e-commerce.
- Collaborate closely with the Creative Director and wider marketing team.
- Work across a large and constantly evolving product portfolio, with 150+ new ranges launched every year.
- Be part of an ambitious period of growth and brand development.

Please note this is NOT a hybrid role.
